description: Source code for unpacking quantized embedding bag weights in PyTorch, including functions for handling 8-bit and 4-bit quantization, and registration of these functions within the quantized namespace.

classes.name: QEmbeddingUnpackWeights
classes.description: Class providing static method to unpack quantized embedding weights.

methods.name: PackedEmbeddingBagWeight::unpack
methods.description: Unpacks quantized embedding bag weights, supporting 8-bit and 4-bit quantization.

methods.name: qembeddingbag_byte_unpack_out
methods.description: Unpacks byte-quantized embedding bag weights into a tensor.

methods.name: qembeddingbag_byte_unpack
methods.description: Helper function to unpack byte-quantized embedding bag weights.

methods.name: qembeddingbag_byte_unpack_meta
methods.description: Provides meta information (shape) for byte-quantized embedding bag weights.

methods.name: _qembeddingbag_nbit_unpack_helper
methods.description: Helper function to unpack n-bit (2 or 4) quantized embedding bag weights.
